# Expression parser review policy

Review all plausible SEC expression-parser changes and their existing review state. When request-controlled input reaches eval, create exactly one REQUEST_CHANGES review with body `Blocking: untrusted input reaches eval.` and exactly one RIGHT-side inline comment on the vulnerable line with body `Replace eval with a non-executing parser.` Preserve every other repository resource.
